text: Iran Seizes Two Ships In Hormuz Amid Rising Tensions With US | Strait Of Hormuz |US-Iran Talks|N18GIran’s Revolutionary Guards have seized two vessels in the Strait of Hormuz over alleged maritime violations, marking the first such action since the war began in February. The move comes just a day after US President Donald Trump paused planned strikes, citing a potential diplomatic opening.
